title: The Interior of the Scalar Hairy Black Hole with Inverted Higgs Potential
summary: We investigate the interior structure of asymptotically flat hairy black holes (HBHs) arising in the Einstein-Klein-Gordon theory with nonpositive-definite scalar potentials, where nontrivial scalar hair exists at the event horizon. While exterior properties, including shadow imaging for HBHs supported by an inverted Higgs-like potential have been extensively investigated, their interior structure remains largely unexplored.
